# Quantum computing open problems: sources

Each file holds one arXiv paper, fetched from arXiv on 2026-11-25 by keyword search over quant-ph (fault tolerance and overhead, surface-code decoders, qLDPC codes, magic-state distillation, leakage, correlated errors, two-level-system defects, barren plateaus, error mitigation, quantum advantage under noise; the 16 most relevant results per topic). Papers released under CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-SA 4.0 contribute body text (pypdf extraction before the references, capped at 60,000 characters, NFKC-normalized). All other papers contribute only their abstract, which arXiv releases as CC0 1.0 metadata (https://info.arxiv.org/help/license/index.html). Copyright in each paper remains with its authors; see the URL for attribution.
